title: BlockOwner
description: Block ownership on the plugin side, the three messages of geldar.<shard>.blockowner.query (BlockOwnerQuery, answered by BlockOwnerReply) and geldar.<shard>.blockowner.changed (BlockOwnerChanged). Minecraft keeps no owner for a block, so geldar-core records the placer of each block the agents place, per chunk, and answers from that record. A block with no record has no owner in these messages: a block that is not in a reply is not owned, and a Body treats it as world-generated. Facts only: an owner is an agent or player id and nothing else; no text is agent-facing. A reply lists at most 4096 owned blocks of one chunk; when the chunk holds more, the plugin sets truncated to true and the Body must not assume the list is complete. Block coordinates are the same as BlockPos in kino-feed.schema.json.

ChunkCoordinate.description: A chunk x or z coordinate.

BlockCoordinateXZ.description: A block x or z coordinate.

OwnerId.description: The placer's agent or player id. Opaque to this contract.

BlockOwnerQuery.description: A Body asks who placed the blocks of one chunk. The plugin replies with a BlockOwnerReply on the reply inbox.

OwnedBlock.description: One block of the chunk that has an owner.

BlockOwnerReply.description: The owned blocks of one chunk. blocks holds at most 4096 entries. truncated is true when the chunk has more owned blocks than the list holds.

BlockOwnerChanged.description: One block's owner changed: a placement sets it, a break or a replacement by another block clears it (owner null). Published by the plugin on geldar.<shard>.blockowner.changed.

owner.description: The new owner, or null when the ownership is cleared.
